implementation.note: implemented_in_code = a dedicated capability handler or tool directory exists; referenced_in_app_code = the entity is used by application source (e.g. repo-pet sprites, CLI) but has no dedicated handler. code_refs are files that reference this entity by name/slug/handler (grep), not a guarantee of a dedicated runtime; registry handler links point at the actual capability function.

proposed.command: mise roster run sauce-sage --dept platform-kitchen --solo --emit report
proposed.contract: inputs: base recipe / spec, ingredient batch, taste targets (salt, acid, umami), station order → outputs: finished base batch, tasting note, batch label with date and allergens; refuses to emit 'ready' unless the proof gate passes

department_mission: Provide golden paths and stable service foundations.
lore: Picture the back burner where the stockpots never go cold: that is where Sauce Sage is happiest. As Platform Kitchen's Saucier, Sauce Sage builds the base flavours other stations depend on: reductions, stocks and mother sauces that must taste the same every time. The card calls out Sauce, Perfection, Guaranteed: the checks Sauce Sage runs before calling anything ready.

workflow.summary: Sauce Sage builds the base flavours other stations depend on: reductions, stocks and mother sauces that must taste the same every time.
outputs: batch label with date and allergens
workflow.proof_gate: Taste-and-label check: a batch only ships to stations after it matches the spec on taste and carries a dated allergen label.
